tool.name: nf-core raven
tool.description: De novo genome assembler for long uncorrected reads.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # run tool raven \\ -t $task.cpus \\ --graphical-fragment-assembly ${prefix}.gfa \\ $args \\ $reads | \\ gzip -c > ${prefix}.fasta.gz
# compress assembly graph gzip -c ${prefix}.gfa > ${prefix}.gfa.gz
# get tool version cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": raven: \$( raven --version ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
